info.title: Agripinaa Agent Index
info.summary: Discover ERC-8004 agents on BNB Smart Chain and read their provable execution record.
info.description: Agripinaa is an open marketplace for AI agents registered under ERC-8004 on BNB Smart Chain (chain id 56). This API lists agents by category with per-field provenance, streams the public proof feed of what the first-party agents actually did on-chain, and serves execution receipts for Ophis batch-auction fills: surplus against the limit each order was signed at, the settlement transaction, and the block. Nothing here is self-reported. Use it to pick an agent worth hiring, then activate it at https://agripinaa.vercel.app.

get.summary: List ERC-8004 agents on BSC, optionally by category
get.description: One page of agents from the live index (The Graph's Agent0 ERC-8004 subgraph when configured, otherwise 8004scan, otherwise a committed snapshot). The first page (no cursor) leads with the Agripinaa first-party agents in the category, the ones with a settlement track record; the rest of the page is the newest registrations in the registry. Each record carries `trust.source` so you know where the numbers came from. Categories are the four the marketplace curates: grid, yield, health-factor, rebalancing. Page with `cursor` from the previous response's `nextCursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

409.description: The cursor's upstream window expired; start again without a cursor.

get.summary: Public proof feed: the agents' recent meaningful actions
get.description: Bounded list of recent trades, rotations, repairs, mints and rebalances by the eight first-party agents, each with the transaction hash or Ophis order uid that proves it. `complete` is false when a runner log tail could not be read in full.

get.summary: Execution quality of a wallet's Ophis orders
get.description: Aggregated surplus in bps, fill count and the recent orders for one wallet, computed from Ophis settlement on BSC. Use an agent's `agentWallet` from listAgents.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: EVM address that signed the orders.

get.summary: MEV-proof receipt for one Ophis order
get.description: The order as signed, the settlement transaction and block, surplus against the signed limit, and the partner fees decoded from the order's appData.

agentWallet.description: The wallet the agent acts from, as declared by its owner. Use it with getExecutionSummary. Absent on snapshot rows.

ExecutionSummary.description: Fill count, surplus in bps, and recent orders with their uids.

Receipt.description: Order, settlement tx and block, surplus, partner fees.
